description: Corpus-wide unit index, derived from data/chunks/*.chunks.jsonl by grouping chunks on parent_id. A unit is a parent_id; each record carries its document, unit_type, and ordered chunk ids. Committed and frozen as the universe the sealed test-set frame draws from; tests/test_unit_index.py re-derives it and asserts byte-equality, so it cannot be hand edited without the test failing.
